notes: Connection-problem logs: the game now keeps a network log of every connection (why a player was dropped, net speed, teams) and keeps the previous game's logs when you restart, so a crash is not lost. Settings > Collect logs for support puts them in the zip (needs SCDA Launcher 3.24, which this release brings). No gameplay changes.
